author: Nelev
body:
## Summary
- The prompt only asked for a `Card` + `Table`, and gpt-4.1-mini often returned `ui: null` even for list questions ("do i have any incoming appointments" got a table 0–1 times in 3).
- The prompt now maps what the answer says to a component, with composition rules and four worked examples; a garbled sentence in the old Display section is gone.
- The UI catalog accepts 12 display components of the json-render shadcn set: Card, Stack, Grid, Separator, Collapsible, Accordion, Table, Heading, Text, Badge, Alert, Progress.
- Left out on purpose: Image/Avatar/Link (URL chosen by the model, from a record that can carry injected text), interactive components (no actions/state), Tabs (bound state), Carousel (renders empty without a browser; awkward in a bubble).

## Test plan
- [x] `ruff check`, `ruff format --check`, `pytest` (172)
- [x] `yarn lint`, `format:check`, `tsc --noEmit`, `test` (69), incl. a render test per new component and for each dropped type
- [x] Live agent run, 12 questions x 2: all 20 specs validate against the catalog; lists get tables, warnings an `Alert` above the table, single facts `Card`+`Text`, S1 and symptoms a lone `Alert`, small talk `null`

Note: the model never picked Badge, Progress, Accordion, Heading or Grid in that run; the prompt says to use them only where they fit.
